content: Resend 6.18.1 is current stable. Peer dep: @react-email/render (optional). Integration pattern: Next.js App Router route handler at app/api/send/route.ts using POST; instantiate new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY); call resend.emails.send({from,to,subject,react:EmailTemplate}). Server Actions also work as an alternative. React Email templates are optional but recommended for HTML emails. The data/error destructuring pattern is used for error handling.
